title: Guinobatan Half Marathon 2026 Review: Albay's Mayon-View 21K
seo_title: Guinobatan Half Marathon 2026 Review | Albay Philippines Race
meta_description: Guinobatan Half Marathon 2026: August 9 in Guinobatan, Albay. A 21.1K from Guinobatan Runners Club with the Mayon Volcano as your backdrop.
dek: Set for 9 August 2026 in Guinobatan, Albay — a town at the foot of Mayon Volcano — this Guinobatan Runners Club event is a single-distance 21.1K. Registration pending.
verdict: The Guinobatan Half Marathon is a community-run 21.1K in Guinobatan — an Albay town that sits directly at the foot of Mayon Volcano, offering what may be the closest road-level view of the perfect cone in Philippine racing. Organised by the Guinobatan Runners Club, it carries genuine grassroots character. A single-distance format keeps it focused. August in Albay is the wet season. For runners wanting an intimate, community-flavoured Philippine half marathon with the Mayon Volcano filling the skyline, this is a unique pick.
